How the counts were checked:

- Parsed from the live (non-commented) `@Controller` and `@Get/@Post/@Put/@Patch/@Delete` decorators in `mycoursea-backend/src`. Many files keep commented-out copies of old controllers; those are excluded.

## 2. Session 1 (2026-10-28): AI visual teaching

### AI visual teaching (Phase 5): implemented and verified end to end

**Pipeline:** learner names a topic or picks their own material → `POST /api/v1/learning/generate` with `kind: visual_lesson` → AI service `POST /api/v1/learn/generate` → structured lesson → stored as a `learning_resources` row → `/learn/resources/:id` renders it through the renderer registry → the learner steps through, rotates 3D models, switches to 2D, asks the tutor (`POST /ai-tutor/explain`) and finishes (`POST /learning/resources/:id/complete`, which counts towards the streak).

**Visual registry v1.** A closed set: AI output is **data**, never code.

| Type | Use | View |
|---|---|---|
| `shape3d` | geometry solids with labelled dimensions | 3D |
| `molecule` | atoms and bonds; deterministic layout computed by the frontend | 3D |
| `vectors` | forces and velocities, with optional resultant | 3D |
| `orbit` | orbits, electron shells | 3D |
| `wave` | travelling waves (instanced particles) | 3D |
| `graph2d` | fixed function families `y = a·f(bx+c)+d`, sampled in code with no `eval` | SVG |
| `flow` | processes and cycles | SVG |
| `labeled` | structures and their parts | 2D |

**Safety.** The lesson is validated three times: in the AI service (`visual_spec.py`), the backend (`src/learning/visual-lesson.ts`) and the frontend (`src/lib/visual-lesson.ts`).

- Unknown types and fields are dropped and numbers clamped; elements must be on an allowlist.
- No URLs, markup, scripts or expressions survive.
- A step whose visual is invalid keeps its text.

**Topic lessons.** A learner can name a topic with no material (`sourceType: 'topic'`, visual lessons only).

- The lesson is labelled "AI-generated from general knowledge". That label is set by the **backend** from the request, never taken from the AI.
- Other kinds still require material.

**Performance and accessibility:**

- the 3D scene is lazy-loaded and client-only (`next/dynamic`, `ssr: false`);
- only the current step's canvas is mounted, so there is one WebGL context, and switching to 2D releases it;
- there is a WebGL capability check;
- an error boundary falls back to 2D;
- with `prefers-reduced-motion`, nothing animates (`frameloop: 'demand'`);
- every visual has a screen-reader description and labels are plain text;
- the AI tutor endpoint is throttled to 1 request per 3 s and 8 per minute per learner.

**Not supported, and not claimed:**

- arbitrary AI-generated 3D models, Blender or GLB assets, or video. The repository contains no GLB/GLTF assets, and GSAP is not installed;
- real-time voice inside lessons.

Adding curated GLB models would need an asset library and a `model` visual type that references assets by an allowlisted id. That is separate work.

**Contract fixes found while doing this:**

- The frontend's `AiTutorExplainPayload` sent `concept`, but the backend DTO requires `input`.
- The AI service's `TutorPayload.context` is a dict; a string context gave a 422, which surfaced to the learner as "AI generation failed".
- Generating a quiz *from* a visual lesson would have sent its JSON as source text. The backend now flattens it to prose (`visualLessonText`).

**Inventory tool:** `scripts/integration-inventory.mjs` (read-only) builds the matrix.

What the `visual-lesson` browser suite covers:

- topic → stored lesson (6 steps);
- the registry renders molecule, vectors and shape as **WebGL canvases** (headless Chrome has WebGL), and graph, flow and labelled parts as SVG or lists;
- the 3D → 2D switch releases the canvas;
- the tutor answers in the lesson;
- finishing records completion on the server;
- another learner gets 404;
- a quiz can be made from the lesson;
- with no WebGL, every 3D visual falls back to 2D with no toggle;
- reduced motion at 375 px has no horizontal overflow.

**Unverified:**

- output from the real AI model (only the mock was used);
- real mobile GPUs;
- screen-reader walkthrough beyond the markup.

## 3. Session 2 (2026-10-29): Practice & exams, learning intelligence, gamification

### Security and correctness fixes (found while integrating)

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| **Question bank:** `POST/PATCH/DELETE /questions` needed only a learner login, so any learner could create, edit or **delete** shared questions | Mutations are now `@AdminOnly(content.manage)`; reads stay learner-accessible. Spec: `src/questions/questions.controller.spec.ts` |
| **Analytics returned fabricated data:** `GET /analytics/mastery` was a hard-coded **78.5%**; courses, topics, weak and strong topics returned fixed placeholder text; nothing wrote `user_performances`, so every figure was 0 | Graded submissions now record performance rows (`src/analytics/record-performance.ts`). Topics, mastery and weak/strong topics come from stored attempt reviews (`src/analytics/topic-stats.ts`). Empty or `null` with no data |
| **Scoped leaderboards were fake:** school/university/department compared a non-existent `school` field, so with no name they returned **everyone**; `course` ignored the course; `friends` returned the global top 10 | Real profile fields (`secondarySchool`, `university`, `department`), case-insensitive, falling back to the learner's own value. `course` ranks enrolled learners only. `friends` answers 501, since there are no friend connections |
| Recommendations for topics, quizzes, revision, exams and the summary were 501 (they used to proxy to an AI that invented catalogue items) | Computed from the learner's own records, each with its real reason (`src/recommendations/learning-recommendations.ts`) |
| Study-plan generation was 501 (it once saved two fixed fake sessions) | Deterministic scheduler from the learner's own course modules or exam subjects plus weak topics (`src/planner/plan-generator.ts`). Regenerating replaces only that target's open generated sessions |
| Calendar was 501 everywhere: its Prisma model never had a table | Moved to TypeORM with a migration (below) |
| Official quiz/test/exam attempts were graded but never stored: start, results, history, readiness and simulate answered 501 | Stored attempts (`src/official-attempts/`) with a migration (below). Submit keeps its contract and still works if the table is absent |

### New migrations (tested locally only; NOT run on production)

| File | Creates | Tested |
|---|---|---|
| `database/migrations/20261028210252_official_assessment_attempts.sql` | `official_assessment_attempts`: owner, kind, assessment, answers, score, per-question review, deadline; a partial unique index allows one open attempt | Applied to the local `gleamlearn_e2e`; browser suite `practice-exams` |
| `database/migrations/20261028230000_calendar_events.sql` | `calendar_events` (snake_case, as the old Prisma model); a CHECK that an event doesn't end before it starts | Applied to the local `gleamlearn_e2e`; browser suite `intelligence`; specs |

Both are additive and fail loudly if the table already exists. Production order after approval: first `baseline` the existing eight tables (`20261028000000`), then `run` for these two. See `mycoursea-backend/database/README.md`.

### Frontend added

- **Practice:**
  - official quizzes, tests and exams start or resume a stored attempt;
  - countdown and auto-submit for timed tests and exams;
  - a "Review your answers" link to `/practice/official/[kind]/attempts/[attemptId]`;
  - exam readiness shown before starting;
  - new tabs: **History**, **Past questions** (plus a question-bank source), **Exam prep plans** (create, edit, delete, countdown), **Performance** (overview, by type, mastery, topics to revise, strong topics).
- **Planner:** **Generate a study plan**; **Study timer** (start, pause, resume, finish; resumes after a reload); **Calendar** (month view; add, edit, delete).
- **Progress:** **Learning progress** and **Level & rank** tabs; leaderboard scopes **My school / My university / My department**.
- **Dashboard:** **What to study next** (continue, topics to revise, practise, exams to try). Topic suggestions open `/learn?topic=…` pre-filled.
- **Libraries:** `src/lib/exam-prep.ts`, `src/lib/next-steps.ts`; extensions to `practice.ts`, `planner.ts`, `gamification.ts`.

## 4. What remains (classified)

Of the 145 learner routes not counted as wired:

- **Wired, but the detector can't see it** (the path is built in a variable): `GET /analytics/overview`, `GET /past-questions`, `GET /questions`. The browser suites exercise all of them.
- **Covered by an equivalent wired route** (no separate screen needed):
  - `xp/level`, `xp/transactions` (covered by `levels/me`, `xp/history`);
  - `coins/transactions` (`coins/history`);
  - `streak/history`, `streak/recovery` (`streak/summary`, `streak/calendar`);
  - `planner/today|week|month` (`/planner`, grouped in the UI);
  - `calendar`, `calendar/week`, `calendar/day` (`calendar/month`);
  - `recommendations/topics|quizzes|revision|exams` (`/recommendations`);
  - `study-sessions/today` (`history`);
  - `quizzes/:id/results`, `tests/:id/results`, `exams/:id/result` (`…/attempts/:id`);
  - `exams/:id/simulate` (the same as `start`);
  - per-id `progress`/`mastery` variants (the overviews);
  - `library/*` aggregates (the Library tabs);
  - search sub-routes (`search/everything`).
- **Server-only, never a screen:**
  - `GET /`, `health/*` (4);
  - `storage/local/:p` (a signed-link target);
  - `payments/webhook` (the provider calls it);
  - `throttler/status` (not mounted: 404);
  - `auth/refresh-token` (the frontend uses access tokens only).
- **Superseded by the self-service flows** (recommend retiring; **needs your decision**):
  - `ai/documents/*` (14) and `quizzes|tests|exams/generate*` (9) are covered by `learning/generate`;
  - legacy `youtube/*` (7) is covered by `youtube-sessions`;
  - `files/*` (6) is covered by `materials`, and `files/:id/process` answers 501 by design.
- **Real gaps still to integrate:**

  | Area | Routes | Note |
  |---|---|---|
  | Voice | `ai/voice/*` (3) | transcribe and synthesize answer 501; `respond` works |
  | Tutor | `ai-tutor/sessions/:id/question` and `answer`, `ai-tutor/drawing-instructions` | |
  | Assistant, companion | `POST ai/conversations`, `DELETE ai-companion` | |
  | Settings | `PATCH users/me/notification-preferences`, `privacy-settings`, `auth/me` | |
  | Public profiles | `users/:id`, `users/:id/achievements`, `users/:id/stats` | |
  | Goals | `goals/:id` (get, patch), `goals/:id/progress` | |
  | Flashcards | list, get, edit; deck edit | |
  | Notes, resources | `notes/:id`; `learning/resources/:id` PATCH (rename) | |
  | Achievements | `achievements/:id` | |
  | Catalogue | `courses/search`, `courses/:id/topics`, `topics/:id` | |
  | Academic structure | `academic-levels`, `institutions`, `faculties`, `departments` (profile pickers) | |
  | Library | favourites | |
  | Leaderboards | `leaderboards/course` (now real; no UI scope yet) | |
  | Lesson progress | `progress/update`, `progress/history` | |
  | Push | `notifications/token` | needs web push, which isn't configured |
  | Reports & feedback | (2) | 501: a Prisma model with no table; needs a migration like the calendar |
  | Usage limits | (4) | 501, for the same reason |
  | Subscriptions & payments | (8) | **contained by design; changing them needs your approval** |
- **Admin console:** 106 routes with no client, plus 34 client-only, across 19 admin modules. Not started in session 2.
- **Navigation regrouping** into about seven sections: not started.

## 5. How to resume (next exact steps)

1. **Start the local stack:**
   - `mock_nim.py`, `smtp_sink.py`, `start-ai-service.mjs <ai repo>`, `E2E_SYNC=false start-backend.mjs` (after `npx nest build`);
   - frontend: `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5055/api/v1 npx next build && npx next start -p 3917`.
2. **If `gleamlearn_e2e` was recreated,** apply both new migrations to it: `node test/live/apply-sql.mjs database/migrations/<file>` (this refuses non-local hosts).
3. **Seed the fixtures:**
   - `node test/live/seed-assessments.mjs` → `SEED`;
   - `node test/live/seed-past-questions.mjs` → `PQ_SUBJECT`.
4. **Run the browser suites:** `practice-exams` (`SEED`, `PQ_SUBJECT`), `intelligence` (`SEED`), `visual-lesson`, `self-learning`.
5. **Next batch:** Reports & feedback and usage limits. Same approach as the calendar: a TypeORM entity plus a migration, and replace the `prismaModel` calls.
6. **Then:**
   - the settings PATCH routes;
   - goals detail and progress;
   - flashcard and resource edits;
   - public profiles;
   - academic pickers;
   - tutor sessions and voice;
   - the navigation regrouping;
   - the admin console module by module (`src/app/admin/(console)`).
7. **After each batch:** regenerate the matrix and update this report.
8. **Afterwards:** run a normal `npx next build`, so `.next` isn't left pointing at the local API.
